import sys, itertools, random, json
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import ref, main as M
found = None
rnd = random.Random(5)
nodes = [1,2,3,4,5]
cand = []
for r in (2,3,4):
    cand.extend(list(p) for p in itertools.permutations(nodes, r))
for trial in range(300000):
    k = rnd.randint(2,6)

    agg = {}
    for p in sel:
        t = tuple(p)
        agg[t] = agg.get(t,0)+1
    final, rounds = ref.ref_peel(agg)
    if any(len(p)==2 for p in final):
        found = (sel, final, rounds); break
if found:
    sel, final, rounds = found
    print("paths:", sel); print("final:", final, "rounds:", rounds)
    core = set()
    for p in final:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    occs = ref.ref_occurrences(final)
    adj = ref.scope_graph(occs, core)
    order = ref.find_order(adj)
    print("core:", sorted(core), "order ok:", order is not None)
    if order:
        doc = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':[{'path':p,'count':1} for p in sel],
               'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[[u,v] for u,v in order],
               'queries':[{'id':'q','path':list(sel[0]),'threshold':[1,2]}]}
        got = M.solve(M.validate(doc)); exp = ref.ref_solve(doc)
        print("match:", got == exp)
        print(json.dumps(got))
